rows: row 0 = north edge, column 0 = west edge
encoding: w: base64 uint8, cells x cells; w / 255 = d / (d + mean), d = usable records per 100 m cell summed over an 11 x 11 box (about 500 m radius), mean = mean of the non-zero d
use: prior = 0.6 + 0.8 * w / 255 (0.6 unrecorded .. 1.4 heavily recorded); a species recorded only under licences a client may not carry is listed with a flat 0 (0.6); species with no record at all: 1 (neutral)
